annotations.text:
The panel in place, at its 420px default.

Click Apply in the proposal: the diff resolves, line 12 changes in the editor behind it, and the terminal replays the build as passing. Tabs switch too.

Panel states, left to right in demo order.

Each one is live — connect a key, allow or deny the build, apply or reject the patch, expand a roadmap item.

The gate. Read-only tools (read, list) run unattended; anything that changes state stops and asks.

That is "propose automatically, apply explicitly" made visible.
Nothing here is invented: colours, radii, shadow, type ramp and JetBrains Mono are lifted from client/src/themes/playground/theme.ts.
